title: Multilingual AI Scribe: How It Works
summary: Learn how a multilingual AI scribe handles code-switching, interpreted visits, speaker roles, clinical notes.
body_markdown:
###


A multilingual AI scribe creates clinical documentation from encounters that include more than one language. It can listen across languages, identify clinically relevant information, and produce a structured note in the clinician's documentation language.


###


Yes, but the system needs to recognize that interpreted speech may repeat content already expressed by the patient or clinician. Good speaker attribution and duplicate handling are important.


###


A well-designed multilingual scribe should handle code-switching inside the same encounter without losing the clinical meaning or treating each language change as a separate topic.


###


No. An AI medical interpreter supports spoken communication during the encounter. A multilingual AI scribe creates clinical documentation from that encounter. The two functions can work together.


###


Yes, some systems can create patient-facing summaries or after-visit information in the patient's language. That output should be written for patient understanding and should match the clinical plan documented in the chart.
